title: Moving Surplus Funds Out of a Savings or Money Market Account
content:
Money is moved out of an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts into another Piedmont Crescent Bank account by online transfer, on the owner's own instruction.

One call posts a single online transfer out of the named account to the receiving account given, lowers the savings account's posted balance by the amount moved, and shows the receiving account as the other side of the entry. The owner sees the transfer on the savings account with today's posting date and a balance lower by that amount, and the money in the receiving account.

### Recording the transfer

The transfer is recorded with the tool `transfer_savings_surplus_c4c79a83`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters

`savings_account_id` — the reference number of the savings or money market account the money is moved out of, taken from the savings account lookup.

`customer_id` — the customer reference number of the account owner, taken from the customer profile lookup.

`destination_account_id` — the reference number of the Piedmont Crescent Bank account receiving the money, taken from the checking account lookup.

`transfer_amount` — the amount moved out, in USD to 2 decimal places, always positive. A value carrying more than 2 decimal places is stored rounded half up to the cent, and the bank's own Eastern Time posting date is used.

### What the call returns

A confirmation sentence carrying the reference number of the transfer entry just created, the amount moved in USD to two decimal places, the reference number of the receiving account, and the savings account's new posted balance in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the transfer completed.
